name: TrustFoundry Legal Search and Reasoning
description: TrustFoundry Legal MCP brings verified US legal search, citation validation, and source-linked summaries into Claude. Research federal and state law, regulations, and case opinions; validate documents for hallucinated or irrelevant citations; and use trusted results to improve drafting. New users can automatically sign up for trial through Claude Connector.

_published_faq.name: How do I add TrustFoundry Legal Search and Reasoning to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add TrustFoundry Legal Search and Reasoning to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.trustfoundry.ai/api/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the TrustFoundry Legal Search and Reasoning MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: TrustFoundry Legal Search and Reasoning provides these MCP tools: describe_search_result, direct_legal_search, file_management_guidance, get_search_results, get_usage, legal_draft, legal_research, legal_review, list_files, and validate_citations.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to TrustFoundry Legal Search and Reasoning?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 18, 2026, alternatives to TrustFoundry Legal Search and Reasoning in legal on the Manufact MCP catalog include GVRN Company Incorporation MCP, Alizé, Ansvar AI, Casepoint, and CiteLaw.

_published_faq.name: Does TrustFoundry Legal Search and Reasoning MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: TrustFoundry Legal Search and Reasoning requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.

_published_faq.name: Who develops TrustFoundry Legal Search and Reasoning?

acceptedAnswer.text: TrustFoundry Legal Search and Reasoning is developed by TrustFoundry. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
